proposed_weighted_criteria.name: Briefteki mesaj, amaç ve istenen içerikle uyum
Onaylı marka kimliği ve diline uyum

mandatory_checks: Doğru marka ve güncel onaylı kaynaklar
İstenen çıktıların tamamı ve doğru dosya sürümü
Çıktı bazında güncel briefin zorunlu mesajları; örneğin onaylı fiyat, tarih ve açıklama metni
score_meaning: Brief/ölçüt uyum puanı; model güven olasılığı veya kanıtlanmış doğruluk oranı değildir
unknown_check: Hold; do not fabricate score or silently give100
policy_acceptance: Weights, inspection methods and output-kind rubrics not yet validated on real WAT deliverables

reference_findings.first_observation: Historical KV omitted mandatory10.99TL/kWh; omission seen in actualPNG and confirmed by Özge's revision comment10327675636
reference_findings.version_rule: Identical filenames are not identical versions; approved candidate and later package must retain separate byte hashes
reference_findings.brief_rule: Use the latest authorized written brief; comment10328077641 refers to an unrecorded verbal change whose exact contents remain unknown
reference_findings.purpose_rule: Background/source assets are not automatically final campaign deliverables; classify purpose before testing required campaign text
reference_findings.stage_rule: Main KV approval is not evidence of inspection of every later resized file;90+automatic QA remains possible only against its own accepted output criteria

second_reference_findings.per_output_scope: Date/price/location amendments apply only to identified outputs and stages
second_reference_findings.additional_output_is_not_a_defect: 1000x666 request was extra work, not evidence previous1920x570 was wrong
second_reference_findings.source_transfer_is_not_delivery: Production ZIP/PSD is not customer-ready output
